canonical_statement: Negative phenomena only manifest in the physical realm if they are accepted into the individual's thought form.

attributions.surface_quote: if you do not absorb that which you accept to be negative... it cannot manifest

canonical_statement: Human beings are ontologically identical to the Divine and possess the capacity to manifest this nature.

attributions.surface_quote: You are God. You are God! ... It is given to you to manifest your God beingness.

canonical_statement: The external world is a projection of the internal state of the individual.

attributions.surface_quote: The world which you envision is already inside of you.

canonical_statement: Physical reality is sustained and defined by the permission of the Divine, which is inherent in humanity.

attributions.surface_quote: Nothing in God’s beingness can exist without the permission of God.

canonical_statement: Evolution is not a transition to a new location, but the internal expansion of the individual's essence.

attributions.surface_quote: You are not moving to another planet. You are breaking out of your shell.

canonical_statement: Human existence is structured across three distinct levels: creation, experiential manifestation, and transition to a new state of being.

attributions.surface_quote: She saw three levels: human creating, experiencing creations, and moving into the new Earth.

canonical_statement: The ultimate evolution of the physical body involves a transition into pure light, culminating in the dissolution of form into omnipresent eternity.

attributions.surface_quote: Physical body turned into pure light... then the light spread into everything.

canonical_statement: The divine state is not an external destination but an inherent quality already present within the individual.

attributions.surface_quote: It is already within you. You are God.

canonical_statement: Human beings are the fundamental source or 'seeding' of divine light within the manifest reality.

attributions.surface_quote: You are seeded with light. You are the seeding.

canonical_statement: The experience of limitation is a self-imposed construct of the spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: you have managed to create a place where you can limit and embrace a limitation

canonical_statement: Time is an illusory framework utilized to facilitate the perception of separation from the whole.

attributions.surface_quote: There is no time. It is an illusion we have created.

canonical_statement: The Absolute is perfect and complete, requiring no external additions or changes.

attributions.surface_quote: God is whole, and requires no additions.

canonical_statement: The act of creation and experience is a dream-state occurring within a limited portion of the Absolute.

attributions.surface_quote: That portion that you speak of is but a portion that is allowed to dream.

canonical_statement: The ultimate nature of reality extends beyond the highest conceptual expansion of divinity.

attributions.surface_quote: There is beyond that.

canonical_statement: The physical body acts as a limiting filter for consciousness to prevent sensory or energetic overload.

attributions.surface_quote: there is only so much that this physical vehicle can absorb of energy.

canonical_statement: The human form is a temporary vessel designed for specific experiential purposes within a manifested reality.

attributions.surface_quote: it has a purpose within that which is manifested here.

canonical_statement: Physical reality is a projection of collective consciousness and is not inherently dense or fixed.

attributions.surface_quote: It only reflects the denseness that you accept.

canonical_statement: Human beings possess the inherent creative capacity to manifest reality as God does.

attributions.surface_quote: you are given to create as God creates.

canonical_statement: Higher states of reality exist internally and are accessible through shifts in consciousness rather than external change.

attributions.surface_quote: that new world that you speak of – exists within you now.

canonical_statement: The individual identity is fundamentally located in a higher state of consciousness beyond the physical form.

attributions.surface_quote: move into that higher place, that higher place that is you.

canonical_statement: Spiritual knowledge is retrieved through a process of internal recollection rather than external acquisition.

attributions.surface_quote: those that are given the task to come across this information and in reading it to recall

canonical_statement: The physical world is an illusory construct.

attributions.surface_quote: she is living in this world, even if it is an illusion.

canonical_statement: Consciousness can exist in a liminal state between the human embodiment and higher dimensional reality.

attributions.surface_quote: she chooses to live in that in-between place.

canonical_statement: Human embodiment is a temporary state permitted for the fulfillment of specific missions.

attributions.surface_quote: we have not kept you in the human form for long

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness originates from and seeks reintegration into a singular, primordial source.

attributions.surface_quote: reintegrate into the All

canonical_statement: The physical world is an illusion, while non-physical states of consciousness represent higher degrees of reality.

attributions.surface_quote: the everyday world... is the illusion, and the dream world is the only reality

canonical_statement: Degrees of reality exist in a hierarchy, with the physical world being the least real and the primordial source being the most real.

attributions.surface_quote: even that place is not the realest of worlds

canonical_statement: Consciousness is capable of temporarily detaching from the physical body to traverse non-physical realms.

attributions.surface_quote: It is allowed nightly for her to leave the body

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is currently undergoing an internal expansion that allows previously suppressed awareness to manifest.

attributions.surface_quote: The mind consciousness is stretching from within, and here comes the information.

canonical_statement: Individual identity is not defined by the sum of past incarnations.

attributions.surface_quote: If past lives were who you are, you would never release yourself from this wheel.

canonical_statement: The cycle of reincarnation is a voluntary construct that can be transcended.

attributions.surface_quote: You are free to be released from this envisionment of all that is your reality.

canonical_statement: The belief in a permanent, separate individual identity acts as a cognitive barrier to higher metaphysical understanding.

attributions.surface_quote: as long as I held to the belief that I was a distinct and separate individual, I would not be ready

canonical_statement: Individual personality and identity are preserved across multiple incarnations.

attributions.surface_quote: We do have an individuality! We do have a distinct and unique personality! But we also had these in all of our other lifetimes.

canonical_statement: Information is transmitted to the conscious mind by external entities during the sleep state.

attributions.surface_quote: we know who put them there during the sleep state.

canonical_statement: Past life experiences remain accessible as emotional and psychological realities within the current identity.

attributions.surface_quote: I can relive those emotions, those attachments, those goals, those failures, just as if they occurred yesterday.

canonical_statement: Individual memories are obscured or integrated into a larger consciousness upon reincarnation.

attributions.surface_quote: After their death... all memory was lost upon their reentry into a new Earth life.

canonical_statement: Individual life experiences serve the purpose of expanding the Source consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: The purpose for us having the experiences... so that the Source can grow.

canonical_statement: The human identity is a fractional splinter of a larger soul entity.

attributions.surface_quote: We are but a very small facet or splinter of a much greater soul.

canonical_statement: The soul is a fragment of the Source, possessing sufficient energy to create worlds.

attributions.surface_quote: Even as a tiny spark, it still contained enough energy to create worlds.

canonical_statement: A single soul can manifest multiple simultaneous incarnations through further splintering.

attributions.surface_quote: These pieces enter the various physical bodies that we are experiencing simultaneously.

canonical_statement: The ultimate metaphysical structure involves a hierarchy of absorption from individual lives to the Oversoul and finally to the Source.

attributions.surface_quote: All of our lifetimes are absorbed again into the Source, the One.

canonical_statement: Human incarnations are cyclical, with memory of past lives being obscured upon death.

attributions.surface_quote: lived a human life and had the memories erased or absorbed upon our death

canonical_statement: The primary purpose of memory retrieval is the resolution of karmic cycles.

attributions.surface_quote: purpose for reviving them would for the recognition and completion of karma

canonical_statement: Individual personality records are preserved in a non-local repository after death.

attributions.surface_quote: records of its accomplishments... will be filed away in the Library on the spirit side

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of existence is perpetual progression and creative expansion.

attributions.surface_quote: Progression is the key... creation proceeds into infinity

canonical_statement: Reality is structured in hierarchical levels, ranging from individual duality to an ultimate, undifferentiated Source.

attributions.surface_quote: three levels: the first... duality... second... God/the Father... third level or ultimate Source

canonical_statement: The intermediate Source requires experiential data to facilitate creation, whereas the ultimate Source is complete and unchanging.

attributions.surface_quote: Source with awareness... needs to learn... ultimate Source... needed no addition or subtraction

canonical_statement: The acquisition of metaphysical knowledge is contingent upon the recipient's state of readiness.

attributions.surface_quote: It will come when I am ready.

canonical_statement: The physical world is a dream-like state or a subset of a larger, non-physical reality.

attributions.surface_quote: go and continue the dream.

canonical_statement: Higher intelligences or non-physical entities respect the autonomy of the individual by withholding information until the individual is prepared.

attributions.surface_quote: They would never push. They would never force.

canonical_statement: Reality consists of both a manifest physical world and a non-manifest unseen dimension.

attributions.surface_quote: balanced between the 'real' world of her family and the 'unseen' world of her work.
